youtube_description:
Robert M. Sapolsky, Ph.D., is the John A. and Cynthia Fry Gunn Professor of Biological Sciences and a professor of neurology and neurological sciences at Stanford University. In this clip from his talk for the Science of a Meaningful Life series, Sapolsky explains when stress can be good for you.

Learn more at: greatergood.berkeley.edu
youtube_title: Robert Sapolsky: When is Stress Good for You?
